seo.title: Massage near Washingtonville, NY | Golden Practice
seo.description: Licensed massage serving Washingtonville, NY — about 20 min from Brooklyn via Routes 208 & 94. Transparent pricing, open every day.

richText.body: From Washingtonville, Routes 208 and 94 bring you over in about twenty minutes. It's an easy add-on to a day at Brotherhood Winery — swap the tasting room for a treatment room and let a massage or facial round out the afternoon.
